mechanism: Modafinil induces CYP3A4, reducing simvastatin metabolism and increasing statin levels, while simvastatin may inhibit modafinil metabolism via CYP3A4, creating bidirectional interaction.
action: Monitor for simvastatin adverse effects (myopathy, elevated liver enzymes); consider alternative statin less dependent on CYP3A4 or reduce simvastatin dose; monitor therapeutic modafinil efficacy.
